actions.reason: Strong biological support: RNA shows FDR-significant upregulation of interferon/inflammatory pathways with large effect sizes, and WXS shows significant BAP1 enrichment (q=0.0044). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with median support count 3 and positive RNA/WSI silhouettes. Confounder exclusion shows a significant site enrichment (CJ) but this is a single technical factor and does not override the coherent biological signal. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

Biological support is absent across all modalities (no significant RNA, WXS, or CNV findings). Cross-modal consistency is driven almost entirely by CT (median silhouette 0.276) with no support from other modalities, and confounder exclusion reveals strong technical associations with CT manufacturer/scanner/kernel (q<0.05). The set appears to be a technical artifact rather than a biological subtype. No structural split or merge is supported, and no available evidence can resolve this.

Biological support is absent across all modalities (no significant RNA, WXS, or CNV findings). Cross-modal consistency is weak with near-zero silhouettes in most modalities and only slight WSI support. Confounder exclusion shows no significant technical associations, but the lack of any biological distinction and weak structural cohesion do not justify acceptance. No structural split or merge is supported, and no available evidence can resolve this.

Biological support is strong: RNA shows 25 significant pathways with coherent downregulation of immune signaling and upregulation of heme metabolism, and CNV shows significant lower copy-number on multiple arms (q<0.05). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with positive WSI and RNA silhouettes and high resampling ARI (0.561). Confounder exclusion shows no significant per-set technical associations. The set has a defensible identity with no dominant technical explanation.

Biological support is moderate: RNA shows 18 significant pathways with coherent upregulation of coagulation/EMT and downregulation of metabolic pathways, though WXS and CNV are not significant. Cross-modal consistency is weak but RNA provides some support (median silhouette 0.021). Confounder exclusion shows no significant per-set technical associations. The transcriptional profile provides a defensible identity, and no better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.
